no COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — diagnosis/treatment act (診療行為) check and calculation subprogram
purpose.summary: This subprogram performs validation and automatic calculation for medical treatment acts (診療行為) in the JMA ORCA receipt system. It checks individual line items (procedures, drugs, materials), handles oxygen supplement auto-addition, anesthesia quantity checks, and computes point totals. It is called with a classification code (LNK-ORCSC-KBN) to perform per-item checks, full checks, or automatic calculation.

notable_features: 14 COPY statements including copybooks for screen, linkage, and parameter areas
LINKAGE SECTION with 4 parameters (MCPAREA, ORCSC00AREA, WRK-SCR-REC, SPA-AREA)
OCCURS table for anesthesia check (TBL-MASUICHK-OCC OCCURS 400)
OCCURS table for nerve block trigger point check (TBL-CHK-OCC OCCURS 31)
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
80 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
Fixed-format source with max line length 74
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese, appearing garbled. This is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The program is a subprogram (called via CALL/LINKAGE) for treatment-act checking and point calculation. Version history in comments shows revisions from 2000 through 2010.
